findings.title: Following desire pulls attention beyond its chosen company
findings.claim: Within the focus verse, desire-following reorients the eyes away from the commanded devotional company, so the endpoint of attention is determined by the desire it follows.
findings.mechanism: The focus words for following, desire, heedlessness, eyes, crossing-away, and excess form a carrier-trigger chain: the eye crosses from the company because the self follows inclination, and the affair is thereby pushed beyond measure.
findings.reader_payoff: The prohibition becomes a visible account of how attention leaves the named company, not a generic warning about preference.
findings.containment: The primary command to remain with the callers and restrain the self remains intact; this finding describes the direction of the prohibited gaze and does not claim that every following is blameworthy.

findings.title: The gaze must not trade enduring company for display
findings.claim: The focus's eye prohibition tests whether visible worldly adornment can displace the lasting company defined by seeking God.
findings.mechanism: Self-restraint and company are set against the eyes' movement toward adornment and nearer worldly life; the resulting contrast makes display a competitor to the chosen devotional relation rather than a neutral object.
findings.reader_payoff: The eye command becomes a test of what is allowed to set social value, while the primary company remains visible.
findings.containment: The focus does not condemn beauty or every adornment; the finding concerns display as a competing value rule and leaves the literal companionship command intact.

findings.containment: The packet supports an attributed trajectory, not a claim that habituated desire is the only cause of the lost water; physical disappearance remains a live alternative.

findings.reader_payoff: The difference between a support network and a protecting affiliation becomes visible across the parable's collapse.
findings.containment: The focus still requires devotional presence with the callers; the attributed affiliation reading does not reduce companionship to a political alliance or claim that followers and protection are identical.
